title: Local auto industry shifts gear to assembly mode
byline: After years of being defined by imported vehicles, Sri Lanka’s automotive industry is beginning to take on a different shape.

title: CCC’s Motor Vehicle Industry Report returns after six-year hiatus
byline: The Ceylon Chamber of Commerce (CCC) has revived its Motor Vehicle Industry Report after a six-year hiatus, reflecting the reopening of Sri Lanka’s vehicle market, following the lifting of the import restrictions.

title: Rs.108bn in tax revenue trapped
byline: Over Rs.108 billion in disputed tax revenue remains locked up in an unresolved backlog at Sri Lanka’s Tax Appeals Commission, a scathing new audit report has revealed, exposing severe administrative paralysis and crippling delays within the state’s tax dispute resolution mechanism.

title: Will proposed Animal Welfare Bill ban elephants in peraheras?
byline: Claims that the proposed Animal Welfare Act would prohibit elephants from participating in cultural processions or completely ban the chaining of elephants are false, the Animal Welfare Coalition (AWC) said.

title: Infantino sorry for errors but stays Fifa president
byline: Gianni Infantino has apologised for ’’errors’’ he made in controversial plans to sell off stakes in competitions to private investors, but will remain Fifa president after receiving the backing of senior executives in a meeting in Morocco.

title: Landslide blocks Nallathanniya-Sri Pada road due to heavy rains
byline: Heavy rainfall in Sri Lanka’s central hills has triggered a landslide, blocking the Nallathanniya-Sri Pada road at the Ehela Kanuwa area.

title: Sri Lanka Navy launches rescue for poaching Indian trawler
byline: The Sri Lanka Navy has initiated a rescue and assistance operation for an Indian fishing trawler that ran aground on a reef off Delft Island following adverse weather conditions while poaching in Sri Lankan waters.

title: Heat-related death toll rises to 21 amid serious heat wave
byline: A total of 21 people have died from heat-related illnesses in South Korea so far this year as the country grapples with intense heat, health authorities said Wednesday.

title: Anti-Corruption Bill to be amended: Govt.
byline: Amendments to the Anti-Corruption Bill will be introduced soon with the aim of removing provisions that lead to adverse situations, Leader of the House Bimal Ratnayake told Parliament today.

title: A/L and Grade 5 Scholarship exams to proceed as scheduled
byline: The G.C.E. Advanced Level Examination and Grade 5 Scholarship Examination will be conducted as scheduled, authorities announced.

title: Beettu office opened in Damana to help reduce human-elephant conflict
byline: A new Beettu Office has been opened under the Damana Site to strengthen efforts to reduce human-elephant conflict in the Siyambalanduwa area.

title: Landslide risk rises in areas affected by Ditwah, NBRO warns
byline: The risk of landslides and rockfalls has increased in areas affected by Cyclone Ditwah due to recent heavy rainfall, the National Building Research Organisation (NBRO) warned.

title: Varsity student fined Rs. 410,000
byline: A varsity student who pleaded guilty of selling hashish and smuggled cigarettes to his fellow students was fined Rs.410,000 by Kuliyapitiya Magistrate Mihil Chiranthana Satharasinghe yesterday.

title: Privacy of politicians who publish their assets, liabilities on CIABOC site will not be restricted: Govt.
byline: Privacy of politicians who publish their assets and liabilities with the Commission to Investigate Allegations on Bribery or Corruption (CIABOC) will not be restricted under the amendment of the Anti Corruption Act, Leader of the House Bimal Ratnayake informed Parliament today.

title: Forest fire accused fined, ordered to pay Rs. 403,509 per hectare in damages
byline: A suspect who pleaded guilty of setting fire to the Seethaeliya forest reserve in Kandapola was fined Rs. 40,000 and ordered to pay compensation of Rs.403,509.22 per hectare of the damage by Nuwara Eliya Magistrate Buddhika Harshani Dharmadasa yesterday(05).

title: Government ready to discuss Animal Welfare Bill with all stakeholders: Minister
byline: The government is ready to discuss the proposed new Animal Welfare Bill with all stakeholders, Minister of Agriculture and Livestock K. D. Lalkantha told Parliament today.

title: Mid-air scare for Trump as chopper carrying him flies too close to passenger jet
byline: US President Donald Trump was at the centre of a reported mid-air safety scare on Tuesday after Marine One, the military helicopter carrying him, allegedly flew within less than a mile of a commercial passenger jet over Washington.

title: Wasp attack leaves over 50 students hospitalised
byline: More than 50 students of Divulwewa Maha Vidyalaya in Trincomalee have been hospitalised after being attacked by wasps, police said.

title: Colombo tops goat and sheep slaughter
byline: Colombo recorded the highest number of goats and sheep slaughtered at licensed slaughterhouses in Sri Lanka during the provisional 2025 period, while Batticaloa reported the highest number of cattle slaughtered, according to the latest statistics released by the Department of Census and Statistics.

title: Govt committed to arrest wrongdoers
byline: Hot on the heels of the arrest of politicians implicated in past wrongdoings, Public Security Minister Ananda Wijepala said yesterday that the government is committed to bring all kinds of wrongdoers to book in conformity with the mandate it received at the last elections.

title: Only one out of four crude coconut oil importers pay taxes: Deputy Minister
byline: Only one out of four crude coconut oil importers pay taxes while the remaining three companies have defaulted, Deputy Minister Nishantha Jayaweera told Parliament today.

title: Petrol bomb attack on Shakib Al Hasan’s home
byline: The house of former Bangladesh cricket captain Shakib Al Hasan in Magura was attacked on Wednesday evening, hours after he appeared virtually at a media interaction addressed by ousted former Bangladesh prime minister Sheikh Hasina from Delhi.

title: Rumesh Tharanga becomes world No. 1 in men’s javelin
byline: Sri Lankan javelin star Rumesh Tharanga Pathirage has achieved a historic milestone by climbing to the No. 1 position in the latest world rankings for the men’s javelin throw, becoming the world’s top-ranked athlete in the event.

title: Sri Lanka seeks mutual legal assistance from five countries
byline: Sri Lanka has sought mutual legal assistance (MLA) from five countries including Zambia to proceed with investigations into the US $ 2.5 million cyber theft, a Minister said yesterday.

title: India calls for early Provincial Council polls, full implementation of Tamil rights
byline: Provincial Council elections should be held at the earliest while constitutional provisions addressing the aspirations of the Tamil community should be fully implemented, Indian Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri said during his official visit to Sri Lanka on Wednesday.

title: Seven-hour water cut in Wellawatte and Pamankada tonight
byline: The National Water Supply and Drainage Board (NWSDB) has announced that the water supply to Wellawatte and Pamankada areas will be temporarily suspended for seven hours due to essential improvement works under the Greater Colombo Water and Wastewater Management Improvement Investment Programme.

title: No change in Litro gas prices for August
byline: Litro Gas Lanka has announced that the prices of its domestic Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) cylinders will remain unchanged for the month of August.

title: Ministers brief Cardinal Ranjith on judicial and prison reform plans
byline: Health and Mass Media Minister Dr. Nalinda Jayatissa and Justice and National Integration Minister Harshana Nanayakkara met Archbishop of Colombo Malcolm Cardinal Ranjith today (06) and briefed him on ongoing judicial and prison reforms.

title: Sri Lanka expands Japan job opportunities for skilled professionals
byline: The Sri Lanka Foreign Employment Agency (SLFEA) has taken steps to expand employment opportunities in Japan for Sri Lankan professionals through a new partnership with Japan-based METATECHNO INC.

title: Kelani Valley commuters stranded after sudden train cancellation
byline: Commuters travelling on the Kelani Valley railway line have been severely inconvenienced following the repeated cancellation of the Colombo Fort–Avissawella semi-express train without prior notice.

title: 280 medical officers seek to migrate so far this year: Deputy Minister
byline: Deputy Health Minister Dr. Hansaka Wijemuni said some 280 medical officers have applied for foreign no-pay leave so far this year.

title: Legal support for Malabe woman harassed over feeding street dogs
byline: A woman who has spent her own money caring for street dogs has received support from the Animal Welfare Coalition (AWC) after an incident involving her while feeding animals in the Malabe area went viral on social media.

title: Are learner drivers barred from using expressways?
byline: Vehicles displaying ‘L’ (Learner) plates and those driven by learner permit holders are not permitted to enter expressways, according to Police.

title: Indian journalist Tarun Tejpal convicted in 2013 rape case
byline: An Indian court has found former Tehelka magazine editor Tarun Tejpal guilty of raping a former colleague, overturning his 2021 acquittal in a decade-old case.

title: Non-SLS helmets seized; two traders fined
byline: The Mahara Magistrate’s Court has fined a retailer and a distributor for selling and distributing protective helmets without the mandatory Sri Lanka Standards Institution (SLS) certification mark and ordered the destruction of the seized stock.

title: Third school term ends tomorrow
byline: The first phase of the third school term for Sinhala and Tamil government and government-approved private schools will officially conclude tomorrow (August 7), the Ministry of Education announced.

title: Coral reef survey conducted in Kayankerni
byline: The Department of Wildlife Conservation (DWC) has completed a comprehensive coral reef survey within the Kayankerni Marine Sanctuary and the adjacent Pasikuda coastal area to evaluate the current status of coral reef ecosystems and strengthen future conservation and management initiatives.

title: Sajith, government MP clash in Parliament
byline: A verbal clash erupted between Opposition Leader Sajith Premadasa and government MP Susantha Nawaratne in Parliament today.

title: Mid-air scare for Trump as chopper carrying him flies too close to passenger jet
byline: US President Donald Trump was at the centre of a reported mid-air safety scare on Tuesday after Marine One, the military helicopter carrying him, allegedly flew within less than a mile of a commercial passenger jet over Washington.

title: TRCSL orders blocking of 146 illegal online gambling websites
byline: The Telecommunications Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka (TRCSL) has instructed all telecommunications service providers to block access to 146 unlicensed online gambling websites in Sri Lanka in a move aimed at curbing illegal online gambling activities.

title: Qatar Airways resumes Bahrain, Kuwait and Erbil flights
byline: Qatar Airways will resume flights to three regional destinations from August 8, restoring services to Bahrain, Kuwait and Erbil as it continues to rebuild its network.

title: No price change for LAUGFS gas
byline: LAUGFS Gas has announced that there will be no change to the prices of its domestic gas cylinder refills for the month of August.

title: SLTB to introduce card payment system for bus travel soon
byline: The time is coming soon for passengers to pay their bus fares by card, Transport and Highways Deputy Minister Prasanna Gunasena said.

title: Iran warns Gulf states: tell Trump to desist or we hit you hard
byline: Iran has made a concerted diplomatic push with Gulf states, warning them explicitly that Tehran will ​hit their oil, power and water plants unless they convince Donald Trump to end U.S. strikes on Iran and instead seek a negotiated end to the war.

title: Rough seas suspend fishing in Matara–Pottuvil sea area
byline: The Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Department has issued an urgent warning to the fishing community, advising fishermen to refrain from venturing into the sea from Matara to Pottuvil via Hambantota due to rough sea conditions.

title: Animals, water board amendment bills passed
byline: The Animals (Amendment) Bill and the National Water Supply and Drainage Board (Amendment) Bill were passed in Parliament today (06).

title: Keep kites away from airports
byline: Airport and Aviation Services (Sri Lanka) (Private) Limited has urged the public to avoid flying kites near airport areas, warning that such activities could pose serious risks to aircraft during take-off and landing.

title: Five officers assigned for child welfare work in each DS Division
byline: Five officers have been assigned to each Divisional Secretariat Division by the Women and Child Affairs Ministry to strengthen child welfare activities, Ministry Secretary  Tharangani Wickramasinghe said today (06).

title: Mirror Missions: Can You Stop the Next Dengue Surge in Sri Lanka?
byline: Take control of a simulated dengue response in Sri Lanka. Make six critical decisions and discover how your choices affect cases, trust and risk.

title: CMC extends deadline for business trade licences until August 31
byline: The Colombo Municipal Council (CMC) has extended the deadline for business premises operating within its limits to obtain trade licences until August 31.

title: Meta becomes latest firm to say its AI hacked another company
byline: Facebook owner Meta has become the latest tech firm to say one of its AI models was able to connect to the internet and hack into another organisation’s systems, during testing.

title: MP’s salary increased by Rs. 60,000
byline: The monthly salaries of MPs have been increased by Rs. 60,000, Member of Parliament Ramanathan Archchuna told Parliament.

title: President orders urgent overhaul of Sri Lanka Police and unified drug rehab push
byline: President Anura Kumara Dissanayake has instructed officials to expedite the modernisation and development of the Sri Lanka Police to ensure the delivery of more efficient and quality services to the public.

title: ASPI surges for a second day as turnover hits LKR 12.24 Bn
byline: The Colombo Stock Exchange extended its positive momentum for a second consecutive session on Thursday, 6 August 2026, as broad-based buying interest lifted both benchmark indices despite another substantial foreign outflow.

title: Pujith, Hemasiri removed from Easter attack civil lawsuit
byline: The Colombo District Court today permitted former Defence Secretary Hemasiri Fernando and former Inspector General of Police Pujith Jayasundara to be removed as defendants from a civil lawsuit filed by an Attorney-at-Law who was injured in the 2019 Easter Sunday suicide bombing at the Shangri-La Hotel.

title: Metro weekend pass gives unlimited rides
byline: Lanka Metro Transit (LMT) has introduced a new Metro Bus Weekend Pass, allowing passengers to enjoy unlimited travel on Metro Bus services throughout the weekend for a one-time fee of Rs. 799.
